t: A high school unit that teaches machine learning through cybersecurity in NetsBlox.
steps: Find the ACT curriculum online and read the activity list.
Create the NetsBlox accounts for your class.
Ask IT to confirm that NetsBlox and the sentiment services are allowed.
Print the Caesar cipher wheel on cardstock and attach it with brad fasteners.
Run Activity 0 yourself to learn the chat app.
Open CODAP and test the data files for the bot detection activity.
Plan about 20 class periods across the unit.
